verdict.rationale: Galileo's Experiments feature runs evaluations across datasets of many inputs at once, and MCP/SDK access lets users programmatically create and manage datasets and run experiments in bulk from code rather than one item at a time (galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-3, galileo-docs-4, galileo-docs-11). However, there is no explicit documentation of bulk edit/delete/tag/annotate operations across arbitrary large sets of existing items in the console or API. Missing for 10: explicit bulk CRUD operations (batch edit/delete/tag) across items, batch API endpoints/rate-limit guidance for large-scale automation, and independent confirmation of bulk-scale reliability.
